objective.title: Preserve chart derivative identities with nine local proof repairs
objective.statement: At exact base ff3ca4b6dce6499f44ab09a0d3ef8dd80a9417dc, retain the authorized original 17 applied extDerivFun to same-model mvfderiv substitutions, three unfolding-name substitutions and exact previously authorized inverse-chart h2 lemma call. Starting dirty ChartIdentification source SHA256 is 2e9280becdc909776f0fc3e216d74118b10b4f8ce155565e47210a9838539ac1; its binary diff and SHA256 are pinned in starting-candidate-receipt-a01.json. Fresh direct gate a01 exited 1 and exposes exactly six additional theorem proof bodies. Repair only nine local regions: extDerivFun_apply_chart h1/h2; isLocallyConstant_of_extDerivFun_eq_zero hInv/hzro'; extDerivFun_apply_mlieBracket_chart heq/final model reduction; and heq within extDerivFun_section_eventually_chart, extDerivFun_extDerivFun_chart, extDerivFun_apply_mlieBracket. All public/private headers, 20 exact types/universes, hypotheses, scalar fields, tangent instances, models, norms, pullback/derivative/chart data, domains, field directions, imports, comments and every other byte remain frozen. Checked routes use hf.mfderiv, definitional scalar-chart identity, expected-type using! conversions and an explicit typed pointwise lieBracketWithin_univ equality. No transparency option is needed or permitted. Original/current generic scalar formulas and exact 20-declaration strict contract/readback are reused unchanged. This supports retained full-root compatibility for proved smoothability S and a separately verified smooth-Poincare consumer, without constructing independent original Hamilton inputs/convergence or claiming final completion.
